default.description: Desktop capability for the main window (tray, folder picker, notifications). The shell talks to a server the user runs; it starts none.

mobile.description: Android/iOS capability for the main window: the mobile shell only hosts the web UI, so it gets the core commands and native notifications — no folder picker (no dialog permission) and no autostart, which do not exist there. There are no app commands to permit either: the shell is a client of a server the user runs.
